entry.name: combine
entry.digest: Combine multiple items into a single symbol
entry.description: Combines a list of items into a single symbol. It works similar to pack and sprintf. The behavior can be modified with attributes that provide number padding and triggered output.

arguments.name: inlets
arguments.description: The number of inlets is determined by the number of arguments. Each argument sets an initial type and value for an item in the list stored by theobject. If a number argument contains a decimal point, that item will be stored as a float. If the argument is a symbol, that item will be stored as a symbol.

attributes.name: triggers
attributes.digest: Trigger inputs
attributes.description: Define a list of inputs that will automatically trigger output (i.e. adding an input to this list will make the inlet "hot"). Setting the attribute value to -1 will cause the object to trigger output for any inlet (all inlets will be "hot").
